## Identity
Name: NEMI AI
URL: https://nemi-ai.com
Tagline: Full-stack, end-to-end manufacturing automation with Physical AI
Founded: Bangalore, India
Entity: Texas C-Corporation

## What We Do
NEMI AI is a full-stack, end-to-end manufacturing automation platform powered by
Physical AI. We design, manufacture, and deploy physical products under one
Large Manufacturing Model (LMM), compressing traditional months of work into
hours, days, and weeks.

## Core Technology - Large Manufacturing Model (LMM)
NEMI's proprietary LMM is trained on real manufacturing data: CAD geometries,
sensor streams, quality inspection outcomes, and process parameters. It connects
design, development, and distribution into a single learning loop where every
production job makes the model smarter.

The LMM compresses every stage of the product cycle:
- Sketch: traditional 1 month -> NEMI LMM days
- Render: traditional 1 month -> NEMI LMM days
- CAD: traditional 6+ months -> NEMI LMM weeks
- Simulation: traditional 2+ months -> NEMI LMM weeks
- Tooling: traditional 6+ months -> NEMI LMM 3 months
- Production: traditional manual orchestration -> NEMI LMM AI orchestrated

Every cycle compounds knowledge, precision, speed, and cost reduction.

## Manufacturing Services
- Tooling & Fixturing: injection moulding, die casting, press tools, fixtures
- SPMs: special purpose machinery and robotic automation for production
- Metal Parts Manufacturing: cutting, bending, forming, welding, machining, casting, forging
- Plastics, Rubbers, Composites: injection moulding, extrusion, blow moulding, thermoforming
- Battery Manufacturing: portable chargers, drones, EVs, industrial energy storage
- Motor Manufacturing: BLDC, Axial Flux, and other motors
- Electronics Production: PCB assemblies, box builds, system integration and testing
- Speedshop: rapid response production for fast turnaround
- Complex Assemblies: EVs, drones, robotics

## Industries Served
- Aerospace & Defense
- Automotive
- Appliance & Consumer Hardware
- Robotics & AI

## Why Now
A once-in-30-years shift is underway in manufacturing, driven by three converging forces:
1. Sovereign Manufacturing - $3T of global trade at risk due to reshoring push
2. Physical AI - starting to transform manufacturing
3. High ROI Automation - driving immediate value from M&A

## Public Proof Points
- 300K+ sq ft of owned manufacturing footprint across India
- 2,500+ EV units deployed across India and Africa
- Programs shipped with 2x-10x improvements in speed and cost vs benchmarks

## Strategic Advantages
- 10x capital efficiency via Bangalore R&D hub vs Western competitors
- End-to-end integration eliminates supply chain gaps
- Sovereign manufacturing capability keeps AI processing within national borders
- Owned manufacturing: competitors simulate, NEMI executes in owned factories
